fusions.name: Closing Distance
fusions.desc: Looses a bolt that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets and draws out every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Tracking Nip
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Quarry in Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Marked for the Chase
fusions.desc: Every hit you land marks that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.
